purpose: New broad whole-event development using corrected production count semantics, preserving all historical studies
forbidden_training: any newly untouched final Rating event
feature_policy: Whole-map complete stable UID counter deltas; supported core objective actors only; corrected credited KPR/multikills/KOST Kill; retain legacy opening/trade/clutch chronology, no guessed credited-victim links; unresolved objective/counter maps excluded
identity_policy: Exact nonnil profiles, or explicitly audited all-nil LAN header UID plus unique exact username adapter; existing independently confirmed public identities only; no fuzzy or counter-derived aliases
quality_policy: Recompute exact credited K/D and rounds without changing old decisions; retain unresolved aliases and incomplete maps; do not require old finisher K/D to match when credited K/D is independently verified
models: exact frozen v2 on original compatible features
exact frozen v2 weights on corrected features
corrected nine-family ridge alpha=1 with supported objective rate
fold_policy: Leave one whole event out; all players/maps of each event remain together; no random row split, hyperparameter/window search or individual old-final residual tuning

prospective_final_gate.subgroup_policy: Predeclare objective-positive and kill-credit-affected residual summaries; any subgroup with at least ten rows must have MAE <= 0.05

historical_finals: Both original v3 failures and v2 benchmark remain immutable and are never rerun/regraded
